title: Build a document-search baseline
summary: Parse documents, retrieve candidate evidence, then evaluate before adding answer generation.

steps.title: Define representative questions
steps.detail: Include answerable, ambiguous, and unanswerable examples with source evidence.

steps.title: Parse with source provenance
steps.detail: Keep document version, page/section, and access-control metadata attached.

steps.title: Run a simple lexical baseline
steps.detail: Inspect which source passages a deterministic token-overlap baseline retrieves.

steps.title: Compare retrieval approaches on the same labels
steps.detail: Measure recall and failure slices before adding generation.

steps.title: Add answers with citations last
steps.detail: Require support from retrieved evidence and allow abstention when it is missing.

title: Evaluate an AI feature before scaling it
summary: Translate a user task into a reproducible test set, compare against a baseline, and inspect failure costs.
audience: Teams deciding whether an AI feature is reliable enough to expand.

steps.title: Define success and failure cost
steps.detail: Specify the user-visible outcome and the costly mistakes, not just response fluency.

steps.title: Build a representative labeled set
steps.detail: Include normal, edge, ambiguous, and unanswerable cases; record data provenance.

steps.title: Run a simple baseline
steps.detail: Compare the smallest design to the proposed system under the same conditions.

steps.title: Track quality and runtime signals
steps.detail: Inspect errors, slices, latency, cost, and traces; do not collapse everything into one score.

steps.title: Publish a reproducible decision record
steps.detail: Capture versions, conditions, limitations, and what decision the result supports.

title: Operate a bounded tool-using agent
summary: Begin with a deterministic workflow, permit only justified model decisions, and put authorization outside the model.
audience: Builders adding tools or actions to an AI application.

steps.title: Write the deterministic workflow first
steps.detail: Mark only decision points that genuinely depend on uncertain context.

steps.title: Define tool authority and side effects
steps.detail: Use least privilege, typed arguments, explicit approvals, retries, and idempotency.

steps.title: Exercise failure and refusal paths
steps.detail: Test malformed tool results, timeouts, replay, untrusted input, and unauthorized actions.

steps.title: Deploy only the minimum runtime
steps.detail: Choose serving and orchestration infrastructure based on measured scale needs.
